s: Minhag shabbat haggadol ubo g' seipim: shabbat shellipne happesach qorin oto "shabbat haggadol", lepi shennaasa bo nes gadol, sheppesach mitzrayim haya miqqecho mibbeasor lachodesh, kemo shekkatub "beasor lachodesh hazzeh veyiqchu lahem ish seh lebet abot vego'", veoto hayyom shabbat haya, shehare beHashem bashshabbat yatzeu yisrael mimmitzrayim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ttz"d, vekevan shet"v benisan haya beHashem bashshabbat, im ken asara benisan haya beshabbat, ukeshellaqechu yisrael pischehem beoto shabbat, nitqabbetzu bekore ummot haolam etzel yisrael ushealum. Lamma zeh hem osin kak? Ameru lahem. Zebach pesach hu laHashem sheyyaharog bekore mitzrayim, haleku bekorehem etzel abotehem veel paroh lebaqqesh mehem sheyyishlechu et yisrael velo ratzu, veasu habbekorot immahem milchama veharegu harbeh mehem, vezehu shekkatub "lemakkeh mitzrayim bibkorehem". Veqabeu nes zeh lezikkaron ledorot beshabbat, uqerauhu "shabbat haggadol". Velamma lo qebauhu baasiri lachodesh setam, ben shechal beshabbat ben shechal bechol, kederek shenniqbeu kol hammoadim? Lepi shebbaasara benisan meta miryam, veqabeu bo taanit keshechal bechol, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"p, ayyen sham:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu shebbeshabbat haggadol bemincha en omerim "borki napshi", ella omerim "abadim hayinu veku'", lepi shebbeshabbat haggadol hayeta hatchalat haggeulla vehannissim. Vaapillu shabbat haggadol hu ereb pesach omerim "abadim hayinu":

Nohagin bimdinot ellu kesheshshabbat haggadol hu ereb pesach, maptirin bo bemalaki "veorba vego'", lepi shebbeoto parasha katub: "habiu…hammaaser el bet haotzar vego'", vahare zeh meen hamora, shebbeereb pesach hu zeman habbiur, dehaynu shebbeereb pesach shel shana harebiit shebbashshemita ubeereb pesach shel shana shebiit shebbashshemita, chayyab kol adam lehotzi mibbeto kol hammaasrot shehiprish mittebuato kol hag' shanim sheaberu mehashshemita, vehayu hammaasrot shehiprish munnachim bebeto, ubeereb pesach zeh mechuyyab lahabian lebet hallevi. (Veap al pi sheyyesh omerim shezzeman habbiur eno beereb yom tob harishon shel pesach ella beereb yom tob haacharon shel pesach, veken iqqar, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman shl"a, mikkol maqom nitpashshet hamminhag al pi sebara rishona).
